price_source: yfinance (Yahoo Finance) daily bars, auto_adjust=False, actions=True
holdout_note: The rule was specified on 2018+ data. Rows marked 'holdout' (<= 2017-12-31) were never examined while choosing the rule and are the only genuinely out-of-sample evidence here.

cost_model.charged: full round trip, every trade, computed per-row from the entry price

trade_definition: Buy at the close of the trading session immediately preceding a scheduled FOMC decision; sell at that decision session's open. No overnight position is held through the 14:00 ET statement.
